# DP.6 signed-sector survival — full triple corpus

Exact s-weighted channel sums over all C(128,3) = 341,376 triple-surface assignments of the 4-cube boundary, negative (spin-3) sector included.  Weight per face with spin n > 0: d_n s^{n(n+2)}; amplitudes from the certified vertex product formula; all arithmetic Fraction-exact.

**Headline: DP.6 SPLIT VERDICT: per-class survival fails — 4 of 34 mixed classes have negative channel sums (each a single monomial, hence negative on ALL of s in (0,1): 1^8 2^11 3^4, 1^9 2^12 3^1, 1^10 2^11 3^2, 1^11 2^11 3^1) — but the GLOBAL sum is certified positive on all of (0,1); cross-class cancellation at each s-exponent restores positivity.**

## Classes (260 spin profiles, 34 mixed)

Every member of a class shares the weight monomial c s^E (c, E fixed by the profile), so each class channel is the exact monomial c (sum Z) s^E and its sign on (0,1) is the sign of the summed amplitude — s-INDEPENDENT, so no crossover in s can occur inside a class.  Pure-positive classes are trivially positive.  Mixed-class and global verdicts go through the repo's sign_on_unit_interval; the 'certified by' column records whether the exact coefficient-sign fast path sufficed or genuine Sturm root counting was needed.
